**ATOMIC_PREPROMPT_EXIT=0** — all stages passed.

**Validation**: 13/13 Jest tests passed across all 3 extraction stages. Syntax validation clean on every atomic write. ESLint layout clean on all 5 files after final pass.

**Traces**: ~40 trace files across `.atomic/traces/` (visible in every operation summary).

**Residual risk**: 288 type-safety lint messages persisted on `unified-agent.service.ts` (`no-unsafe-call`, `no-unsafe-assignment`, `no-unsafe-member-access`, `no-redundant-type-constituents`) — non-layout, unfixable by ESLint `--fix`. These are pre-existing type-resolution gaps, not regressions from the extraction.
